notes.title: New Updates Coming Your Way
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I come back to you with some very exciting news!

As a reward for your support and patience, the VRParadise Team has been hard at work in order to release a lot of new in-game features and new content! These new features will be spread out over a couple of updates coming your way!

- The club will have new rooms for you to explore! Unlock access to these special rooms by completing tasks!
- The club's bartender will be adding new cocktails to the menu! Feel free to serve and offer them to your favorite strippers!
- Withdraw some cash with our new ATM machine and play with the DJ set-up.
- Some of you were dying to watch female customers enjoying lap dances...well we have some good news…You can expect new female customers in the club, as well as new male customers and a new security crew.
- You'll also have the possibility to interact with NPCs through missions to unlock items, features, and new rooms.

In addition, our 3D artist is also working on new outfits for the strippers.

The first major update is currently being tested internally, but it should be available in a couple of weeks.
We will be teasing these new features through pictures and videos regularly as you wait for the first beta version to be released.
We are so excited to show you what we've been working on for the past months and we're sure you are going to love it.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE NOW (Patchnote 1.12)
notes.content:
We have some new and exciting game modifications and we can’t wait for you guys to try them out. We have been working hard in order to make your experience the best it can be!

Here’s a brief list of what to expect with this version:


- Shortcut added in order to make it easier for players to personalize each stripper whether in the striclub or during a private dance.

- 150+ animated reactions have been introduced and are triggered during customization of any stripper in the club.

- Finger tracking on Valve Index is now available and will allow players to have precise and fluid hand and finger movements.

- We have been working with Polywink to give the strippers genuine facial expressions. To do this, we have based these expressions on an actual female face to make them look as authentic and real as possible. This is a very new project that we have been working on so this is only the beginning! Many more facial expressions are in the making and will hopefully be added soon.

- Volume optimization and stripper dialogue improvements.

- Prominent and recurring bugs have been fixed.

- Finally, we are introducing a new graphic charter on our website. This change will only impact the game’s launch icone, but more alteration will be made in the future.


We hope you enjoy these new changes!

The VR Paradise Team

Models

notes.title: Early access ending
notes.content:
The whole VR Paradise team is extremely proud of the work done and all the excellent reviews and suggestions we got from the gamers on Steam, Discord, and Twitter. 
You have been a great help and have inspired us throughout this year and for years to come!

We’ve been collecting all the feedback, fixing the bugs and working to make the full version of VR Paradise the best experience for everyone.

Ending the early access means diving into a new journey! 
Now, it's getting serious! We have so many projects for 2020 and ensure we meet your expectations. 

Some of that work includes adding new content for the game (Strippers, outfits, new stripclub...), improving existing features like "Strippers Editor" or "Manage your club" fields and many other features, some highly anticipated and others that will surprise you ^_^

We hope you’re going to love all of it and our Early Access players deserve a huge mega-thanks for joining us on this journey!

We are experiencing a technical issue due to the change to pay mode (instead of free 2 play).

notes.title: Patch note 0.084
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016292/3996710028b07bb71fa0ac0febca90ae4c62f0a4.jpgHello Guys! 

This version contains the following features: 

[olist]
 You can stop the table or private dance. If you stop a table dance, you simply return in the club after a quick fade in / fade out. If you stop a private dance, you stay with the girl who asks if you want to exit the room or another dance. If you do nothing, you return the club after 20 secs. We have planned a mode that will allow you to stay with the girl as much time as you want, but it's not yet activated.

 You don't show the money anymore to ask for a dance but brings up a menu (with the same button) which will allow you to choose several options. For now, all options are not available but the idea behind is to add interaction between players and dancers.

 You can play without controllers - Pretty useful if you own a old Oculus and have no controllers of want to test VR Paradise on your mobile with riftcat. 

 You can choose the skin color of your hands. 

 Talking about your hands, we have fixed hands collision with 3D assets like glasses or menus on the table. 

[/olist]
Besides features:

This version also announces a significant change in the economic model:

VR Paradise switches from a free 2 play to a paid game (at the same price). 
This seems to be the natural step to take after setting up the DLC which has always been a temporary solution for us. 
Negative reviews due to misunderstanding that resulted from the F2P model cost us far too much. 

Geek's note: we have migrated to Unreal Engine 4.21 - It was a pain in the a** but it worth it ^_^ !

This release fixes some bugs and adding the graphic and audio settings menu as well as game settings and DLC VIP membership

DLC
The In-app purchase of the vip membership has been replaced by a DLC and this has 3 major improvements: 
[olist]
Anyone who had problems buying in STEAM VR will now be able to do it simply from the store. 
It's much easier to manage refunds because it's fully compliant with refund steam policy.
You can play offline
[/olist]
We also believe the DLC brings more transparency on what players can expect from the free version versus the pay version.

Of course, This DLC will automatically be added to anyone who has already purchased the in-app lifetime membership. 

ACHIEVEMENT BUG FIX
"Home run"  and "Visit all teleports" achievements work fine now.

NEW GIRL VOICES 
We have added 3 new voices. We try to make each of them unique. For example, among the 3 new voices, there is one with a sexy french accent :).

MENU SETTINGS:
You can now set parameters in the game by clicking on the "setting" button of the controller.
By the way, using the exit teleport don't make you quit the game anymore, but get you back in the lobby.

notes.title: VR Paradise Patch 0.81.001 : New Pricing
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016292/d2f97c2cce927e6062715eca3522b7b29d44750a.jpg

DEV NOTES :

When we have designed VR PARADISE, we wanted to create the most realistic virtual stripclub possible, meaning with the possibility for members to pay for lap/private dances on demand.

Reading your comments, it seems obvious that it wasn't the right way to do it.
We understand that this system doesn't fit what most gamers expect and we have decided to react quickly!

No need to spend game credits every time you want a lap or private dance anymore, all you have to do is to buy a lifetime membership to unlock all table & private dances.

Users that have already bought credits in app, will also receive their lifetime membership.

We know that many players have been very impressed by the quality of the gameplay but didn't take the plunge, cooled up by the rates. We hope that this change will meet your expectations.


GAMEPLAY
 Lifetime membership (unlimited lapdances).
 Breast physics improved.

BUG FIXES
 Fixed a bug in the game engine that made the game crash sometime.
